question:
Simplify the following.

30% of [{(820% of 40) - 28}] % of 600
solution:
**Given:**

Complex expression: 30% of [{(820% of 40) - 28}] % of 600

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Solution:**

⇒ 30% of [{(820% of 40) - 28}] % of 600

⇒ 30% of [328- 28] % of 600

⇒ 30% of [300] % of 600

⇒ 540

**Hence, the simplified expression is 540. **
